After going through the facts and circumstances of the case and also the terms and conditions of the contract, this Court is satisfied that there is no violation as of any of the terms and conditions by the petitioner.
Further, there is clear violation of principles of natural justice in issuing the termination order.

Though in the written instructions, the respondents contend that no orders have been issued for blacklisting the petitioner, the petitioner's name has been shown in the list of blacklisted contractors while issuing other tenders.
Therefore, such an action of the respondents is unsustainable and is unjustified.
